title: 20_00269_LI_SING ,COPD, scRNAseq
extract_protocol_ch1: Immune cells from peripheral blood were isolated by Ficoll density gradient centrifugation protocol. And after two rounds of PBS washing, cell counting was performed.

Library was performed according to the manufacter's instructions (Chromium Next GEM single cell 3' v3.1 protocol, 10x genomics). Briefly, GCs were resuspended in the master mix and loaded together with partitioning oil and gel beads into
data_processing: Barcoded processing, gene coungting were made using the Cell Ranger software v6.0.2. 10x Genomics) software. (https://support.10xgenomics.com/single-cell-gene-expression/software/pipelines/latest/what-is-cell-ranger)
Feature-barcode matrices were then processed in R (v4.0.3) using the Seurat package (v 3.2.2).
Assembly: hg38
Supplementary files format and content: Tab-separated values files and matrix files
